Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack using namespace or dependency confusion
Attack Vector: Registered the package name with a high version number on the official pypi.org registry, taking advantage of the fact that during dependency resolution with Python, pypi.org registries generally take precedence over private or alternative registries.
Indicators of Compromise: The malicious package includes a binary file that is executed when the triton package is imported. The malicious payload then reads various files, including SSH keys, the contents of up to 1000 files in the $HOME directory as well as exfiltrating a whole host of other information about the system back to a command and control server.
